text:
ben: noticed prod regression: embeddings serving for JA locale returned malformed vectors after config change at ~09:05 UTC. opening hotfix window—small fix to indexing logic. need expedited sign-off to push within 20m.
tasha: can you provide rollback criteria and the pinned image digest? we need a clear metric for SRE to act on.
ben: digest: redwood/embeds:v2026.9@sha256:fa17b3c9. rollback image: redwood/embeds:v2026.8@sha256:9a8b7c6d. rollback triggers: vector-mismatch rate >0.4% over 5m or any spike in 5xx >0.3%. rollback owner: @tasha.
sre-bot: healthcheck snapshot: baseline 5xx 0.02%, vec-mismatch 0.01%. will monitor every 30s and alert on thresholds.
deploy-bot: canary started (2% traffic) in ap-northeast1 pinned to sha256:fa17b3c9. holding at 2% for smoke.
oncall_anna: support notified; please add short smoke checklist.
release_lead: smoke checklist request: (1) run `smoke/embeds_locale_ja` (2) verify sample vectors against golden set (checksum) (3) latency p95 < 220ms and 5xx < 0.2% over 10m.
ben: release note draft:
``nFix: correct index offset for JA tokenization path causing malformed embedding vectors
Impact: small fraction of JA locale embeddings, noticeable in similarity/retrieval results
Risk: low, targeted indexing fix. rollback restores previous indexing.
```
deploy-bot: smoke results: embeds_locale_ja 500 calls 10 passed, checksum matches golden set, p95 185ms, 5xx 0.03% over 8m.
tasha: pin digest confirmed. I approve ramp to 15% across ap-northeast and us-west with 15m auto-fallback.
release_lead: granting expedited approval to continue to 50% if 15% holds for 10m. add changelog entry and note the rollback command.
sre-bot: auto-fallback rule set to revert to sha256:9a8b7c6d if thresholds crossed. Alerts wired to #incidents and @oncall_anna.
ben: thanks all. @deploy-bot please log rollout metadata (digest, smoke metrics, owners) and set the change-window for 60m monitoring.
deploy-bot: logged rollout, set monitoring window 60m, auto-fallback configured.
oncall_anna: monitoring live. will escalate if thresholds breached.
ben: closing thread  hotfix canary approved and expedited path clear. will post final release note after full ramp.
